Execute development through v12 using existing CLI/bootstrap/template mechanisms; v11 tracks transitional coordination only, no second authority for the same Work. First discovery slice yields retained candidate/continuation for reviewer classification; no worker direct host database access/general Work-creation service. Human Git/integration approval retained. Focused deterministic proofs by default. First step: bounded existing-code gap assessment and first executable native slice with mechanical kickoff, not a broad redesign/new launcher.
